# `adt strust`

STRUST SSL certificate management (Personal Security Environments)

```bash
adt strust [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command             | Description                                             |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt strust list`   | List Personal Security Environments (STRUST identities) |
| `adt strust get`    | List certificates installed in a PSE                    |
| `adt strust put`    | Upload a PEM-encoded certificate into a PSE             |
| `adt strust delete` | Delete a certificate from a PSE                         |

## `adt strust list`

List Personal Security Environments (STRUST identities)

```bash
adt strust list [options]
```

**Options**

| Option   | Description            | Default |
| -------- | ---------------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output results as JSON |         |

## `adt strust get`

List certificates installed in a PSE

```bash
adt strust get [options] <context> <applic>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument    | Description                            | Default |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<context>` | PSE context (e.g., SSLC, SSLS)         |         |
| `<applic>`  | PSE application (e.g., DFAULT, ANONYM) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt strust put`

Upload a PEM-encoded certificate into a PSE

```bash
adt strust put [options] <context> <applic> <pem-file>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description                                  | Default |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<context>`  | PSE context (e.g., SSLC, SSLS)               |         |
| `<applic>`   | PSE application (e.g., DFAULT, ANONYM)       |         |
| `<pem-file>` | Path to a PEM-encoded X.509 certificate file |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt strust delete`

Delete a certificate from a PSE

```bash
adt strust delete [options] <context> <applic> <cert-id>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument    | Description                            | Default |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<context>` | PSE context (e.g., SSLC, SSLS)         |         |
| `<applic>`  | PSE application (e.g., DFAULT, ANONYM) |         |
| `<cert-id>` | Certificate id (from `adt strust get`) |         |

**Options**

| Option      | Description              | Default |
| ----------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-y, --yes` | Skip confirmation prompt | `false` |
| `--json`    | Output as JSON           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
